Name: Mattan, Priest of Baal
Summary: Mattan, priest of Baal, was slain before the altars when Jehoiada's purge broke down Baal's house and altars in Jerusalem.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, High Priest; Athaliah; Joash, King of Judah; Jehoiada, the Priest
LifeLesson: Baal's priest fell with Baal's house the day the true king was crowned.
